mission_04: Great work on personalized federated learning! You have implemented techniques that allow each client to maintain a model adapted to their unique data distribution while still benefiting from collaborative training. The regularization approach prevents local models from drifting too far from the global model, maintaining some shared knowledge. Model interpolation provides a simple yet effective way to blend global and local knowledge. Personalization is especially important in non-IID settings where a single global model cannot serve all clients well. Real-world applications include personalized keyboard prediction, health monitoring on wearables, and recommendation systems where user preferences vary significantly.
